subject: health
essentialQuestion: How do I make a sound decision, set a goal I can reach, and advocate for health beyond myself?

prompts.prompt: Explain a step-by-step decision process in your own words and give or identify a valid example.

Use a diagram of a general figure or character rather than your own body, a picture sequence, a model, a described demonstration, or a checked source, to show what you learned about checking sources and spotting misinformation.
Apply what you learned about influences from peers, family, and media to a new fictional situation. Show the steps or name the source you relied on.
A made-up character makes an unsafe or unreliable choice involving setting and tracking a personal health goal. Explain what is wrong, correct it, and say why the correction is safer.
Connect a step-by-step decision process with advocating for a healthier community. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Set a private-safe personal health goal with a plan and a progress check, and produce an advocacy piece supported by a reliable source. Goals may not target body weight, body size, or appearance.
Name one skill you can now use somewhere else, one way to check your own work, and one question you still have. This is about the skill, not about your private life; nothing private has to be shared.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
